cues.text: Frame 0, settled: the water heater in the middle, plumber one close on the left, plumber two close on the right. Left plate: $3,100 in red. Right plate: $150 in gold. At 0.5 s a plain cut to the heater close, the two prices on it, the left one red, the right one gold (the first change). On "prices" a plain cut back to the two plumbers, the same plates.
A plain cut to plumber one, close, at the heater, clipboard up. The plate: 2 MINUTES. On "dead" a stamp: DEAD. in red. On "thirty" a stamp: NEW ONE: / $3,100, the last row big and red.

The frame splits for a phone call: the homeowner left on a wine wall, phone to her ear; plumber two right on a slate wall, a phone at his ear. The plate across the top: REENACTMENT. On "Can" it gives way to the homeowner's line, her side lit: HOMEOWNER / CAN YOU STILL / COME LOOK? On "I'll" it gives way to his line, his side lit: PLUMBER 2 / I'LL LOOK.

A plain cut to plumber two, close, at the heater. The plate: IT WORKS. On "swapped" the pipe on top gets a new piece and the plate gives way to: A LEAKING PIPE. On "hundred" a stamp: $150, big and gold. On "Hot" a plain cut to the homeowner, close, smiling, steam off a mug: HOT WATER / IS BACK.
A plain cut to the homeowner, close, phone to her ear. The plate: PLUMBER 3? On "Cancelled" a stamp: CANCELLED in red.

A plain cut to the heater, close, its label plate. The plate: THE TANK. On "ten" a stamp: 10 YEARS OLD, big and red. On "Some" a plain cut to the heater a step back, no one in the frame: SOME SAY / NEAR THE END.

The frame splits, one person a side: plumber one on a slate wall left, plumber two on a teal wall right. Left plate: UPSELL? / $3,100 in red. Right plate, on "fair": FAIR / WARNING? / 10 YEARS, in teal.

A plain cut to the utility room, plumber one left holding the clipboard out to the homeowner right, who reads it. The card lands: SHOW WHAT / YOU TESTED / BEFORE REPLACE, the middle row big and gold. Ends 1 s after the last word.
